definition: used to talk about a choice between two possibilities
sentence: I do not know {whether} to take the bus or walk.
translation: Не знаю, ехать на автобусе или идти пешком.

definition: an important or typical part or quality of something

translation: Лучшая особенность телефона — его камера.

definition: the act of firing a gun or kicking a ball, or a photograph

translation: Его последний удар попал прямо в ворота.

definition: the dry part of the Earth's surface, or an area of ground

translation: После двух недель в море мы были рады увидеть землю.

definition: a mother or father

definition: very large or important

translation: Пробки — серьёзная проблема в больших городах.

definition: a long flat piece of wood, or a group of people who run a company

translation: Учитель написал новые слова на доске.

definition: a film shown at the cinema or on TV

translation: Вчера вечером мы смотрели страшный фильм.

definition: more, or to a greater distance or degree

translation: Сегодня мы не можем идти дальше, темнеет.

definition: a person in a story, or the qualities that make someone who they are

translation: Главный герой истории — молодой врач.

definition: in the middle of a group of people or things

translation: Дом стоял среди высоких деревьев.

definition: used when the person speaking is also the person who receives the action
sentence: I cut {myself} while cooking dinner.
translation: Я порезался, пока готовил ужин.

definition: used when the person you are speaking to also receives the action
sentence: Be careful not to hurt {yourself} with that knife.
translation: Осторожно, не порежься этим ножом.

definition: a place where people study after leaving school
sentence: My brother is studying art at {college}.
translation: Мой брат учится на художника в колледже.

definition: something you want to achieve, or a point scored in football
sentence: Her {goal} is to run a marathon next year.
translation: Её цель — пробежать марафон в следующем году.

definition: easy to understand or see, or without clouds or marks
sentence: The instructions were {clear} and easy to follow.
translation: Инструкции были понятными и простыми.

definition: to have clothes, shoes or jewelry on your body
sentence: I always {wear} a hat in the sun.
translation: На солнце я всегда ношу шляпу.

definition: a large public area with grass and trees in a town
sentence: The children are playing football in the {park}.
translation: Дети играют в футбол в парке.

definition: a small copy of something, a person who shows clothes, or a type of product

translation: Он построил модель корабля из дерева.

definition: to arrive at a place, or to stretch out your arm to touch something

translation: Мы доберёмся до деревни до темноты.

definition: how much money something is worth, or how useful or important it is

translation: Стоимость старой картины всех удивила.

definition: a number, or the shape of a person's body

translation: В отчёте указана цифра в два миллиона посетителей.

definition: to divide or open something with a knife or scissors, or to make smaller
sentence: Please {cut} the bread into thin slices.
translation: Пожалуйста, нарежь хлеб тонкими ломтиками.

definition: moving or happening quickly
sentence: This is the {fast} train; it stops only twice.
translation: Это скорый поезд, он останавливается только дважды.

definition: with all its parts; whole, or finished
sentence: The library has the {complete} works of Shakespeare.
translation: В библиотеке есть полное собрание сочинений Шекспира.

definition: despite the fact that; even though
sentence: {Although} it was late, we kept talking.
translation: Хотя было поздно, мы продолжали разговаривать.

definition: enjoyment or pleasure, or something that makes you happy
sentence: We had a lot of {fun} at the beach.
translation: Мы здорово повеселились на пляже.

definition: a plan or set of ideas agreed by a government or company
sentence: The new {policy} helps families with young children.
translation: Новая политика помогает семьям с маленькими детьми.

definition: to grow or change into something bigger or better, or to make something new
sentence: Children {develop} quickly in their first years.
translation: В первые годы дети быстро развиваются.

definition: something that is made or grown to be sold
sentence: The company sells its {product} in thirty countries.
translation: Компания продаёт свою продукцию в тридцати странах.

definition: a place with many houses and shops, smaller than a city
sentence: We live in a small {town} by the sea.
translation: Мы живём в маленьком городке у моря.

definition: good or acceptable, or very thin, or sunny
sentence: The weather was {fine}, so we ate outside.
translation: Погода была хорошая, и мы ели на улице.

definition: to include something as a necessary part, or to make someone take part
sentence: The job will {involve} a lot of travel.
translation: Работа будет связана с частыми поездками.

definition: to get pleasure from something
sentence: I really {enjoy} walking in the rain.
translation: Мне очень нравится гулять под дождём.

definition: a game between two teams or players, or a small stick for making fire
sentence: The football {match} ends at nine.
translation: Футбольный матч заканчивается в девять.

definition: the part of something that faces forward or is nearest to you
sentence: Write your name on the {front} of the book.
translation: Напиши своё имя на обложке книги.

definition: to complete something, or to come to an end
sentence: I need to {finish} this report by Friday.
translation: Мне нужно закончить этот отчёт к пятнице.

definition: the number 6
sentence: There are {six} eggs in the box.
translation: В коробке шесть яиц.

definition: a report that gives an opinion about a book, film or product
sentence: The film got a good {review} in the newspaper.
translation: Фильм получил хороший отзыв в газете.

definition: at the back of something or someone
sentence: The dog is hiding {behind} the sofa.
translation: Собака прячется за диваном.

definition: relating to the government or public affairs of a country
sentence: The two friends never talk about {political} questions.
translation: Эти двое друзей никогда не говорят о политике.

definition: to some degree; fairly, or completely
sentence: The exam was {quite} difficult this year.
translation: В этом году экзамен был довольно сложным.

definition: the direction where the sun goes down in the evening
sentence: The sun sets in the {west}.
translation: Солнце садится на западе.

definition: a male parent
sentence: My {father} taught me to ride a bike.
translation: Отец научил меня кататься на велосипеде.

definition: a female parent
sentence: Her {mother} is a teacher at our school.
translation: Её мать — учительница в нашей школе.

definition: a place that keeps and lends money, or the land along a river
sentence: I need to go to the {bank} to get some cash.
translation: Мне нужно сходить в банк за наличными.

definition: to hold something and take it to another place
sentence: Can you help me {carry} these bags upstairs?
translation: Поможешь мне отнести эти сумки наверх?

definition: to let something fall, or to fall or become lower
sentence: Be careful not to {drop} the plates.
translation: Осторожно, не урони тарелки.

definition: to become a member of a group, or to connect two things
sentence: Would you like to {join} our book club?
translation: Хочешь вступить в наш книжный клуб?

definition: to connect two things, people or ideas
sentence: A new bridge will {link} the two towns.
translation: Новый мост соединит два города.

definition: to not remember something
sentence: Do not {forget} to lock the door tonight.
translation: Не забудь запереть дверь сегодня вечером.

definition: to want something to happen, often something unlikely
sentence: I {wish} I could speak Italian.
translation: Жаль, что я не говорю по-итальянски.

definition: a person who loves a team or performer, or a machine that moves air
sentence: He is a big {fan} of jazz music.
translation: Он большой поклонник джаза.

definition: the middle point or part of something, or a building for an activity
sentence: There is a fountain in the {center} of the square.
translation: В центре площади стоит фонтан.

definition: a group of people who meet for a shared interest, or the place they meet
sentence: She belongs to a chess {club} in town.
translation: Она состоит в шахматном клубе в городе.

definition: an empty area, or the area beyond the Earth where the stars are
sentence: There is not enough {space} in the room for another bed.
translation: В комнате недостаточно места для ещё одной кровати.

definition: happening or existing now
sentence: What is your {current} address and phone number?
translation: Какой у тебя нынешний адрес и номер телефона?

definition: able to be used, bought or found, or free to see someone
sentence: Tickets are still {available} for tonight's show.
translation: Билеты на сегодняшнее шоу ещё есть в продаже.

definition: the process of teaching and learning, usually at school
sentence: Every child has the right to a good {education}.
translation: Каждый ребёнок имеет право на хорошее образование.

definition: happening or existing before, but not now
sentence: The {former} president now writes books.
translation: Бывший президент теперь пишет книги.

definition: prepared for what you are going to do, or finished and able to be used
sentence: Dinner is {ready}; please come to the table.
translation: Ужин готов, прошу к столу.

definition: on some occasions but not always
sentence: We {sometimes} go to the sea on Sundays.
translation: Иногда по воскресеньям мы ездим на море.

definition: to become bigger or taller, or to make plants develop
sentence: Children {grow} fast at this age.
translation: В этом возрасте дети быстро растут.

definition: the way two people or groups feel and behave towards each other
sentence: She has a good {relationship} with her parents.
translation: У неё хорошие отношения с родителями.

definition: to go to see a person or place for a short time
sentence: We {visit} my grandmother every Sunday.
translation: Мы навещаем бабушку каждое воскресенье.

definition: money that people must pay to the government
sentence: The government raised the {tax} on cigarettes.
translation: Правительство подняло налог на сигареты.

definition: to be flat on a surface, or to say something that is not true
sentence: I like to {lie} on the grass and watch the clouds.
translation: Я люблю лежать на траве и смотреть на облака.

definition: an emotion, or something you sense in your body
sentence: I had a strange {feeling} that someone was watching me.
translation: У меня было странное чувство, что кто-то за мной наблюдает.

definition: two people who are married or in a relationship, or two things
sentence: The young {couple} moved into the house next door.
translation: Молодая пара въехала в соседний дом.

definition: done or approved by the government or someone in authority
sentence: The {official} opening of the bridge is on Monday.
translation: Официальное открытие моста в понедельник.

definition: a period of relaxing or sleeping, or the part that is left
sentence: After the long walk we needed a {rest}.
translation: После долгой прогулки нам нужен был отдых.

definition: an animal with four legs that people keep as a pet or for guarding
sentence: Our {dog} barks at every stranger.
translation: Наша собака лает на каждого незнакомца.

definition: one part of a large organization, shop or university
sentence: She works in the sales {department}.
translation: Она работает в отделе продаж.

definition: a change that happens because of something else
sentence: The medicine had a quick {effect} on his fever.
translation: Лекарство быстро подействовало на его жар.

definition: a small spot or line on a surface, or a score in a test
sentence: There is a dirty {mark} on your shirt.
translation: У тебя на рубашке грязное пятно.

definition: a length of time, or one lesson at school
sentence: The shop was closed for a long {period} last year.
translation: В прошлом году магазин был долго закрыт.

definition: to decide which of several things you want
sentence: You can {choose} any cake you like.
translation: Можешь выбрать любой торт, какой нравится.

definition: to have the same opinion as someone, or to say yes to a plan
sentence: I {agree} with you that the film was too long.
translation: Согласен с тобой, что фильм был слишком длинным.

definition: a member of the police or army with a position of authority
sentence: A police {officer} stopped the car for speeding.
translation: Полицейский остановил машину за превышение скорости.

definition: the production of goods in factories, or one type of business
sentence: The car {industry} employs thousands of people here.
translation: Автомобильная промышленность даёт здесь работу тысячам людей.

definition: a boy or man who has the same parents as you
sentence: My older {brother} lives in Berlin.
translation: Мой старший брат живёт в Берлине.

definition: to give your attention to a sound or to what someone says
sentence: Please {listen} carefully to the instructions.
translation: Пожалуйста, внимательно слушайте инструкции.

definition: a competition to see who is fastest, or a group of people with similar looks
sentence: She won the hundred-meter {race} at school.
translation: Она выиграла забег на сто метров в школе.

definition: to say what someone or something is like
sentence: Can you {describe} the man who took your bag?
translation: Можете описать мужчину, который взял вашу сумку?

definition: a piece of paper that shows how much you must pay, or a proposed law
sentence: The waiter brought us the {bill} after dinner.
translation: После ужина официант принёс нам счёт.

definition: to make or grow something, or to cause a result
sentence: This farm can {produce} tons of apples every year.
translation: Эта ферма может производить тонны яблок каждый год.

definition: to take hold of something moving, or to get on a bus or train
sentence: Try to {catch} the ball with both hands.
translation: Попробуй поймать мяч обеими руками.

definition: from one side of something to the other
sentence: We walked {across} the bridge to the old town.
translation: Мы перешли по мосту в старый город.

definition: used when the man or boy who does the action also receives it
sentence: He hurt {himself} while playing football.
translation: Он ушибся, играя в футбол.

definition: not inside a building or place
sentence: The children are waiting {outside} the school.
translation: Дети ждут у школы.

definition: most important or largest
sentence: The {main} road into town is closed today.
translation: Главная дорога в город сегодня закрыта.

definition: the thing that people pay most attention to, or clear sight
sentence: Safety is the {focus} of the new rules.
translation: В центре внимания новых правил — безопасность.

definition: safety from danger or crime, or the people who protect a building
sentence: The airport has very strict {security}.
translation: В аэропорту очень строгая охрана.

definition: a choice that you make after thinking about something
sentence: We made the {decision} to sell the house.
translation: Мы приняли решение продать дом.

definition: the warmest season of the year, between spring and autumn
sentence: We spent the whole {summer} by the sea.
translation: Мы провели всё лето у моря.

definition: the surface of the earth that you walk on, or a piece of land
sentence: The apples fell to the {ground} in the wind.
translation: Яблоки падали на землю от ветра.

definition: one side of a sheet of paper in a book, or a web document
sentence: Open your books at {page} twenty.
translation: Откройте книги на двадцатой странице.

definition: a piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine
sentence: I read an interesting {article} about sleep.
translation: Я прочитал интересную статью о сне.

definition: the body part at the end of the leg, or a unit of length
sentence: I hurt my {foot} playing football.
translation: Я ушиб ногу, играя в футбол.

definition: in place of someone or something else
sentence: There was no milk, so I drank tea {instead}.
translation: Молока не было, так что вместо него я выпил чай.

definition: a man who rules a country because his family did so before him
sentence: The {king} lived in a castle on the hill.
translation: Король жил в замке на холме.

definition: things that a person owns, or a building and its land
sentence: The police returned the stolen {property} to its owner.
translation: Полиция вернула украденное имущество владельцу.

definition: the power that makes machines work, or the strength to be active
sentence: Solar panels turn sunlight into {energy}.
translation: Солнечные панели превращают свет в энергию.

definition: newspapers and magazines, and the people who write for them
sentence: The {press} was waiting outside the court.
translation: Пресса ждала у здания суда.

definition: the state something or someone is in, or something that must happen first
sentence: The old car is still in good {condition}.
translation: Старая машина всё ещё в хорошем состоянии.

definition: happening often or found in many places, or shared by a group
sentence: Rain is {common} in this part of the country.
translation: Дождь — обычное дело в этой части страны.

definition: an area of a state or nation with its own local government
sentence: They live in a small village in the next {county}.
translation: Они живут в маленькой деревне в соседнем округе.

definition: the part someone plays in a film, or their job in a situation
sentence: She has a leading {role} in the new play.
translation: У неё главная роль в новой пьесе.

definition: shaped like a circle or a ball
sentence: The children sat at a {round} table.
translation: Дети сидели за круглым столом.

definition: complete, or including everything
sentence: The {total} cost of the trip was two hundred dollars.
translation: Общая стоимость поездки составила двести долларов.

definition: an event where people come together to discuss or decide things
sentence: The {meeting} starts at nine in the main office.
translation: Совещание начинается в девять в главном офисе.

definition: how big or small something is
sentence: What {size} shoes do you wear?
translation: Какой размер обуви ты носишь?

definition: the woman that a man is married to
sentence: His {wife} works at the hospital.
translation: Его жена работает в больнице.

definition: one of the ways the body notices things, like sight, or a feeling or meaning
sentence: Dogs have a very good {sense} of smell.
translation: У собак очень хорошее обоняние.

definition: a person who manages a company, or who makes a film
sentence: The {director} of the film won an award.
translation: Режиссёр фильма получил награду.

definition: to rest with your eyes closed and your mind not awake
sentence: I usually {sleep} for eight hours.
translation: Я обычно сплю восемь часов.

definition: being male or female, or the physical activity between people
sentence: The form asks for your name, age and {sex}.
translation: В анкете спрашивают имя, возраст и пол.

definition: something you say or write that gives an opinion
sentence: She made a kind {comment} about my work.
translation: Она сделала доброе замечание о моей работе.

definition: a small piece of stiff paper or plastic, used for games, messages or paying
sentence: I sent my aunt a birthday {card}.
translation: Я отправил тёте открытку на день рождения.

definition: a level of quality that is expected or accepted
sentence: The {standard} of food in this restaurant is high.
translation: Уровень кухни в этом ресторане высокий.

definition: doing something many times to get better, or the usual way of doing it
sentence: You need more {practice} before the concert.
translation: Тебе нужно больше практики перед концертом.

definition: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it
sentence: You should {drink} more water in hot weather.
translation: В жару нужно пить больше воды.

definition: a shop, or a place where things are kept until needed
sentence: There is a new clothes {store} on our street.
translation: На нашей улице открылся новый магазин одежды.

definition: to be connected with something, or to tell a story
sentence: Many health problems {relate} to poor sleep.
translation: Многие проблемы со здоровьем связаны с плохим сном.

definition: very pleasant to look at or listen to
sentence: What a {beautiful} garden you have!
translation: Какой у вас красивый сад!

definition: a time when people vote to choose a leader or government
sentence: The next {election} will be held in May.
translation: Следующие выборы пройдут в мае.

definition: to dislike someone or something very much
sentence: I {hate} getting up early in winter.
translation: Ненавижу вставать рано зимой.

definition: how much there is of something
sentence: A small {amount} of salt makes the soup tastier.
translation: Небольшое количество соли делает суп вкуснее.

definition: one person, considered separately from a group
sentence: Every {individual} has the right to speak freely.
translation: Каждый человек имеет право говорить свободно.

definition: a large boat that carries people or goods across the sea
sentence: The {ship} sailed from Lisbon to New York.
translation: Корабль отплыл из Лиссабона в Нью-Йорк.

definition: the name of a book, film or song, or a word before someone's name
sentence: I cannot remember the {title} of the song.
translation: Не могу вспомнить название песни.

definition: acting, singing or playing music for an audience, or how well something is done
sentence: Her {performance} in the play was wonderful.
translation: Её игра в спектакле была великолепна.

definition: the raised floor in a theater where actors perform, or one step in a process
sentence: The singer walked onto the {stage} and smiled.
translation: Певица вышла на сцену и улыбнулась.

definition: a number of different things of the same type, or the limits between two amounts
sentence: The shop sells a wide {range} of shoes.
translation: Магазин продаёт широкий ассортимент обуви.

definition: to lift something to a higher position, or to increase an amount
sentence: {Raise} your hand if you know the answer.
translation: Поднимите руку, если знаете ответ.

definition: to give an answer without being sure it is right
sentence: Can you {guess} how old she is?
translation: Можешь угадать, сколько ей лет?

definition: a building where Christians meet to pray
sentence: The old {church} stands in the center of the village.
translation: Старая церковь стоит в центре деревни.

definition: a part of something, or one item of a type
sentence: Would you like another {piece} of cake?
translation: Хочешь ещё кусочек торта?

definition: a little cold, or calm, or very good in informal speech
sentence: The evening was {cool} after the hot day.
translation: Вечер после жаркого дня был прохладным.

definition: to believe that someone is honest and will not harm you
sentence: I {trust} my doctor completely, so I follow her advice.
translation: Я полностью доверяю своему врачу, поэтому следую её советам.

definition: more than usual, or more than others
sentence: I love fruit, {especially} strawberries in summer.
translation: Я люблю фрукты, особенно клубнику летом.

definition: almost the same, but not exactly
sentence: The two sisters have very {similar} voices.
translation: У двух сестёр очень похожие голоса.

definition: without any mistakes or faults; as good as possible
sentence: It was a {perfect} day for a picnic.
translation: Это был идеальный день для пикника.

definition: typical or normal, or found by adding amounts and dividing
sentence: The {average} temperature in July is thirty degrees.
translation: Средняя температура в июле — тридцать градусов.

definition: a feeling of worry, or something that worries you
sentence: Her main {concern} is the health of her children.
translation: Её главная забота — здоровье детей.

definition: a picture made with a camera
sentence: Let me take a {photo} of you by the fountain.
translation: Давай я сфотографирую тебя у фонтана.

definition: a way of doing something, or a way of dressing or designing things
sentence: I like the {style} of this old house.
translation: Мне нравится стиль этого старого дома.

definition: the number of points each team or player has in a game
sentence: The final {score} was three to two.

definition: to get something useful or wanted, or to increase

definition: to move your body to music

translation: Мы любим танцевать на вечеринках.

definition: belonging to me

translation: Тот синий зонт у двери — мой.

definition: a long natural flow of water that goes into the sea or a lake

definition: the place where bad people are punished after death, or a very bad situation

translation: Последняя неделя экзаменов была адом.

definition: a type or kind of person or thing

definition: words that are written down, or the activity of putting words on paper

translation: Я отправил письмо, но не получил ответа.

definition: to move something away from you with your hands or body

translation: Толкни дверь, чтобы открыть.

definition: the thin threads that grow on your head and body

translation: У неё длинные каштановые волосы и зелёные глаза.

definition: to control or organize something, or to succeed in doing something difficult

translation: Она будет руководить новым магазином в городе.

definition: very surprising and wonderful
sentence: The view from the top was {amazing}.
translation: Вид с вершины был потрясающий.

definition: relating to trade, industry and money

translation: Страна переживает экономический кризис.

definition: used when the thing that does the action also receives it
sentence: The cat washed {itself} by the fire.
translation: Кошка умывалась у огня.

definition: bad or dangerous, or not joking or playing
sentence: The patient is in a {serious} condition.
translation: Пациент в тяжёлом состоянии.

definition: something that you say or write officially, or a bank record

translation: Полиция попросила его дать показания.

definition: a period of one hundred years

translation: Замок был построен в двенадцатом веке.

definition: harm done to something, or the loss it causes

translation: Буря сильно повредила крышу.

definition: to tell people something officially or publicly

translation: Компания объявит о своих планах завтра.

definition: to sit on a bicycle or horse and travel, or to travel in a vehicle

translation: Я каждый день езжу на работу на велосипеде.

definition: communication with someone, or the act of touching

translation: Я потерял связь со школьными друзьями.

definition: to speak or act for a group, or to be a sign of something

translation: Она будет представлять нашу школу на соревновании.

definition: the art, beliefs and way of life of a group of people

translation: Я хочу узнать о японской культуре.

definition: the number, street and town where a person lives or works

translation: Напиши свой адрес на конверте.

definition: a legal written agreement between people or companies

translation: Он подписал двухлетний контракт с клубом.

definition: to start a company or system, or to show that something is true

translation: Они решили основать школу в деревне.

definition: belonging to the sex that can have babies or lay eggs

translation: Самка птицы сидит на яйцах.

sentence: Do you know how to {operate} this camera?
translation: Ты знаешь, как пользоваться этой камерой?

definition: a person who writes books or articles
sentence: Who is the {author} of this novel?
translation: Кто автор этого романа?

definition: the salt water that covers most of the Earth
sentence: We swam in the {sea} every morning.
translation: Мы каждое утро купались в море.

definition: something that is studied at school, or the thing talked about
sentence: History is my favorite {subject} at school.
translation: История — мой любимый предмет в школе.

definition: a place where you buy and drink alcohol, or a long thin piece of something

translation: Мы встретились в баре рядом с вокзалом.

definition: to try to find or get something

translation: Многие молодые люди ищут работу в городе.

definition: having come out of the mother's body and started life

translation: Она родилась в маленькой деревне в 1990 году.

definition: whole or complete
sentence: We spent the {entire} day at the museum.
translation: Мы провели в музее целый день.

definition: possibly; maybe

translation: Возможно, нам стоит спросить дорогу.

definition: the right or chance to enter a place or use something

translation: У студентов есть бесплатный доступ в библиотеку.

definition: one of the parts that something is divided into
sentence: The sports {section} is at the back of the newspaper.
translation: Спортивный раздел в конце газеты.

definition: a series of planned activities to achieve something, such as winning an election
sentence: The {campaign} against smoking was very successful.
translation: Кампания против курения была очень успешной.

definition: a person who is in charge of a shop, team or part of a company
sentence: The {manager} of the hotel welcomed us.
translation: Управляющий отелем встретил нас.

definition: a large group of soldiers trained to fight on land
sentence: He joined the {army} when he was eighteen.
translation: Он пошёл в армию в восемнадцать лет.

definition: a small fact or piece of information
sentence: Tell me every {detail} of your trip.
translation: Расскажи мне все подробности поездки.

definition: the act of protecting someone or something from attack
sentence: The castle walls were built for {defense}.
translation: Стены замка были построены для защиты.

definition: a shape made of two lines that go across each other, or a Christian symbol
sentence: She wears a small gold {cross} on a chain.
translation: Она носит маленький золотой крестик на цепочке.

definition: to be the right size or shape, or to put something in a place
sentence: These shoes do not {fit} me; they are too small.
translation: Эти туфли мне не подходят, они слишком малы.

definition: with little or no light, or closer to black than white
sentence: It gets {dark} early in winter.
translation: Зимой темнеет рано.

definition: to show that something is true
sentence: Can you {prove} that you were at home last night?
translation: Ты можешь доказать, что был дома вчера вечером?

definition: a journey for pleasure during which you visit several places
sentence: We went on a {tour} of the old city.
translation: Мы отправились на экскурсию по старому городу.

definition: a unit for measuring temperature or angles, or a qualification from a university
sentence: It is thirty degrees today, one {degree} warmer than yesterday.
translation: Сегодня тридцать градусов, на градус теплее, чем вчера.

definition: to ask for something firmly, as if you have a right to it
sentence: The workers {demand} higher pay and shorter hours.
translation: Рабочие требуют повышения зарплаты и сокращения рабочего дня.

definition: to understand or notice something, or to make a plan happen
sentence: I did not {realize} how late it was.
translation: Я не понял, как уже поздно.

definition: to find the size, amount or speed of something
sentence: Let us {measure} the room before we buy the carpet.
translation: Давай измерим комнату, прежде чем покупать ковёр.

definition: very strange or not sensible, or mentally ill
sentence: It was a {crazy} idea to swim in winter.
translation: Купаться зимой было безумной идеей.

definition: the achieving of what you wanted, or a person or thing that does well
sentence: The concert was a great {success}.
translation: Концерт прошёл с большим успехом.

definition: one program in a TV or radio series, or one event in a longer story
sentence: I missed the last {episode} of the show.
translation: Я пропустил последнюю серию шоу.

definition: at the present time; now
sentence: She is {currently} working in Berlin.
translation: Сейчас она работает в Берлине.

definition: relating to money and how it is managed
sentence: The company has serious {financial} problems this year.
translation: В этом году у компании серьёзные финансовые проблемы.

definition: from or in another country
sentence: She speaks two {foreign} languages very well.
translation: Она очень хорошо говорит на двух иностранных языках.

definition: allowed by law, or relating to the law
sentence: It is not {legal} to park here.
translation: Парковаться здесь незаконно.

definition: only, or in an easy or plain way
sentence: The dish is {simply} fish, rice and salt.
translation: Блюдо — это просто рыба, рис и соль.

definition: extremely good, in informal speech
sentence: We had a {super} time at the beach.
translation: Мы отлично провели время на пляже.

definition: a collection of songs released together, or a book for photos

translation: В прошлом месяце группа выпустила новый альбом.

definition: the number 10
sentence: There are {ten} chairs around the table.
translation: Вокруг стола десять стульев.

definition: to cause pain or injury, or to feel pain

translation: Осторожно, этот нож может тебя поранить.

definition: a tall plant with a trunk, branches and leaves
sentence: An old oak {tree} stands in front of the house.
translation: Перед домом стоит старый дуб.

definition: to move by turning over and over, or to make something into a tube
sentence: The ball started to {roll} down the hill.
translation: Мяч покатился вниз по холму.

definition: to think that something is probably true
sentence: I {suppose} she is at work now.
translation: Полагаю, она сейчас на работе.

definition: every day

translation: Музей открыт ежедневно с девяти до пяти.

definition: twice as much, or made of two parts
sentence: We booked a {double} room with a sea view.
translation: Мы забронировали двухместный номер с видом на море.

definition: how fast something moves or happens
sentence: The car was traveling at high {speed}.
translation: Машина ехала на большой скорости.

definition: all the people living in a country, town or area
sentence: The {population} of the city is two million.
translation: Население города — два миллиона.

definition: to give people something they need or want
sentence: Farms {supply} the city with fresh vegetables.
translation: Фермы снабжают город свежими овощами.

definition: how heavy something is
sentence: What is the {weight} of this bag?
translation: Сколько весит эта сумка?

definition: not easy to do or understand
sentence: The exam was very {difficult} this year.
translation: В этом году экзамен был очень трудным.

definition: of the present time, or using the newest ideas and methods
sentence: The new library is a very {modern} building.
translation: Новая библиотека — очень современное здание.

definition: liked by many people
sentence: Football is a {popular} sport in Brazil.
translation: Футбол — популярный вид спорта в Бразилии.

definition: used to ask or say who something belongs to
sentence: {Whose} coat is this on the chair?
translation: Чьё это пальто на стуле?

definition: to connect one thing with another in your mind
sentence: Many people {associate} summer with holidays.
translation: Многие связывают лето с отпуском.

definition: the real facts about something, not lies
sentence: Please tell me the {truth} about what happened.
translation: Пожалуйста, расскажи мне правду о том, что случилось.

definition: a small round mark, or a particular place
sentence: This is a nice {spot} for a picnic.
translation: Это хорошее место для пикника.

definition: to move upwards, or to increase
sentence: The sun will {rise} at six tomorrow.
translation: Завтра солнце взойдёт в шесть.

definition: the feeling you have when you are frightened
sentence: She has a {fear} of spiders.
translation: Она боится пауков.

definition: to make something ready, or to get ready for something
sentence: I need to {prepare} dinner for six people.
translation: Мне нужно приготовить ужин на шестерых.

translation: Вся семья приехала встречать нас в аэропорту.

definition: to say numbers in order, or to find how many there are
sentence: The children can {count} from one to twenty.
translation: Дети умеют считать от одного до двадцати.

definition: a program for a phone or computer, or a formal request for a job
sentence: I use an {application} to learn new words.
translation: Я пользуюсь приложением, чтобы учить новые слова.

definition: the information or ideas in a book, film or website
sentence: The {content} of the website is free for everyone.
translation: Содержимое сайта бесплатно для всех.

translation: Моя сестра на два года старше меня.

translation: Каждый рабочий на заводе получает бесплатный обед.

translation: Сохрани файл перед тем, как закрыть программу.

translation: Земля обходит вокруг Солнца раз в год.

definition: to make sounds with your voice that show you are happy or find something funny

translation: Шутка рассмешила всех в комнате.

translation: Я заметил внезапное движение в кустах.

definition: an opening with glass in a wall that lets in light and air
sentence: Open the {window}; it is hot in here.
translation: Открой окно, здесь жарко.

definition: to move forward, or to make progress
sentence: The army began to {advance} towards the city.
translation: Армия начала наступать на город.

definition: the force pressing on something, or strong attempts to make someone do something
sentence: She is under a lot of {pressure} at work.
translation: На работе на неё сильно давят.

definition: a person whose job is to treat sick people
sentence: You should see a {doctor} about that cough.
translation: Тебе стоит показаться врачу с этим кашлем.

definition: the feeling you have in your body when you are hurt or ill
sentence: I have a {pain} in my back.
translation: У меня болит спина.

definition: extremely large
sentence: An elephant is a {huge} animal.
translation: Слон — огромное животное.

definition: the system that connects computers all over the world
sentence: I found the recipe on the {internet}.
translation: Я нашёл рецепт в интернете.

definition: a polite word used to speak to a man
sentence: Excuse me, {sir}, you dropped your glove.
translation: Извините, сэр, вы уронили перчатку.

definition: an electronic machine that stores information and does calculations
sentence: I use my {computer} for work and games.
translation: Я пользуюсь компьютером для работы и игр.

definition: the medical care given to a sick person, or the way you behave towards someone
sentence: The {treatment} for the illness takes three weeks.
translation: Лечение болезни занимает три недели.

definition: one of the things you can choose
sentence: We have two options: the train or the {option} of driving.
translation: У нас два варианта: поезд или вариант поехать на машине.

definition: a person with great skill, or a man who has control over others
sentence: He is a {master} of the guitar.
translation: Он мастер игры на гитаре.

definition: a place to sit, such as a chair or a place on a bus
sentence: Is this {seat} free, or is someone sitting here?
translation: Это место свободно или здесь кто-то сидит?

definition: a large formal meeting where people talk about a subject
sentence: She gave a talk at a science {conference}.
translation: Она выступила с докладом на научной конференции.

definition: to reach the place you are going to
sentence: The train will {arrive} at half past six.
translation: Поезд прибудет в половине седьмого.

definition: to say that you will certainly do something
sentence: I {promise} to call you tonight.
translation: Обещаю позвонить тебе сегодня вечером.

definition: an organization of people with a shared interest, or a connection
sentence: He is a member of the teachers' {association}.
translation: Он член ассоциации учителей.

definition: what you think or believe about something
sentence: In my {opinion}, the film was too long.
translation: По-моему, фильм был слишком длинным.

definition: the person who something belongs to
sentence: The {owner} of the dog paid for the damage.
translation: Владелец собаки заплатил за ущерб.

definition: in a lower place, or later in a text
sentence: Write your answer in the box {below}.
translation: Напишите ответ в поле ниже.

definition: of the color of chocolate or earth
sentence: He has short {brown} hair and a beard.
translation: У него короткие каштановые волосы и борода.

definition: a person who uses a product, machine or service
sentence: Every {user} needs a password to log in.
translation: Каждому пользователю нужен пароль для входа.

definition: something you aim at, or a result you try to achieve
sentence: Our {target} is to sell a thousand tickets.
translation: Наша цель — продать тысячу билетов.

definition: making you laugh, or strange
sentence: He told us a very {funny} story.
translation: Он рассказал нам очень смешную историю.

definition: the person you live with or are married to, or a person you work with
sentence: She started the business with a {partner}.
translation: Она начала бизнес с партнёром.

definition: a way of doing something, especially a planned one
sentence: This is a good {method} for learning new words.
translation: Это хороший метод для изучения новых слов.

definition: a group of people chosen to make decisions for a larger group
sentence: The {committee} meets every Monday at ten.
translation: Комитет собирается каждый понедельник в десять.

definition: having a low temperature
sentence: It is very {cold} outside; wear a coat.
translation: На улице очень холодно, надень пальто.

definition: clearly defined; one particular thing, not general
sentence: Is there a {specific} reason for your visit?
translation: У вашего визита есть конкретная причина?

definition: measuring a lot from one side to the other
sentence: The river is too {wide} to swim across.
translation: Река слишком широкая, чтобы переплыть.

definition: to repair something, or to attach it firmly
sentence: Can you {fix} my broken bike?
translation: Можешь починить мой сломанный велосипед?

definition: a piece of equipment with moving parts that does a job
sentence: This {machine} makes coffee in one minute.
translation: Эта машина готовит кофе за минуту.

definition: a person who paints, draws or makes other art
sentence: The {artist} painted a picture of the harbor.
translation: Художник написал картину гавани.

definition: the crime of killing a person on purpose
sentence: The police are investigating the {murder}.
translation: Полиция расследует убийство.

definition: to make something more modern or add the latest information
sentence: You should {update} the app to the new version.
translation: Тебе стоит обновить приложение до новой версии.

definition: one part in every hundred
sentence: Only ten {percent} of the students failed.
translation: Только десять процентов учеников не сдали.

definition: happening or made a short time ago
sentence: Have you seen any {recent} films?
translation: Ты смотрел какие-нибудь новые фильмы?

definition: without a bend or curve, or honest
sentence: Draw a {straight} line with the ruler.
translation: Проведи прямую линию по линейке.

definition: to accept something unpleasant, or to carry or hold up weight
sentence: I cannot {bear} the noise from the street.
translation: Я не выношу шум с улицы.

definition: to ask someone questions for a job, a newspaper or a program
sentence: The reporter will {interview} the mayor tonight.
translation: Репортёр возьмёт интервью у мэра сегодня вечером.

definition: used to make offers and suggestions, or to talk about the future
sentence: {Shall} we go for a walk after lunch?
translation: Пойдём гулять после обеда?

definition: the fact of not having enough of something
sentence: The plants died from a {lack} of water.
translation: Растения погибли от недостатка воды.

definition: to start a new product or activity, or to send a rocket into space
sentence: The company will {launch} a new phone in May.
translation: Компания выпустит новый телефон в мае.

definition: to mention or talk about someone or something
sentence: Please {refer} to page ten for the answers.
translation: За ответами обратитесь к десятой странице.

definition: a fight between armies, or a hard struggle
sentence: Many soldiers died in the {battle}.
translation: В битве погибло много солдат.

definition: to hit someone or something hard, or to stop working as a protest
sentence: The clock will {strike} twelve at midnight.
translation: В полночь часы пробьют двенадцать.

definition: a business that provides a service, or a government department
sentence: We booked the trip through a travel {agency}.
translation: Мы забронировали поездку через турагентство.

definition: to cause a change in someone or something
sentence: Bad weather can {affect} your mood.
translation: Плохая погода может повлиять на настроение.

definition: a substance like air that is not solid or liquid, or fuel for cars
sentence: We cook on {gas} at home.
translation: Дома мы готовим на газе.

definition: something added, or the act of adding numbers together
sentence: The new sofa is a nice {addition} to the room.
translation: Новый диван — хорошее дополнение к комнате.

definition: the reason for doing something, or what something is for
sentence: What is the {purpose} of your visit?
translation: Какова цель вашего визита?

definition: a person who invites guests, or who presents a TV or radio show
sentence: Our {host} cooked a wonderful dinner.
translation: Хозяин приготовил нам чудесный ужин.

definition: a group of musicians who play together, or a thin flat strip
sentence: My brother plays the drums in a rock {band}.
translation: Мой брат играет на барабанах в рок-группе.

definition: the process of growing or increasing
sentence: The city has seen rapid {growth} in ten years.
translation: За десять лет город быстро вырос.

definition: the skill or power to do something
sentence: She has the {ability} to learn languages fast.
translation: У неё есть способность быстро учить языки.

definition: a group of things kept together, or the act of collecting
sentence: He has a large {collection} of old coins.
translation: У него большая коллекция старых монет.

definition: the power to give orders, or an organization with official power
sentence: The teacher has {authority} over the class.
translation: Учитель обладает властью над классом.

definition: on the evening or night of today
sentence: Let us go to the cinema {tonight}.
translation: Пойдём сегодня вечером в кино.

definition: the way parts are arranged, or something built
sentence: The {structure} of the essay is clear.
translation: Структура сочинения понятна.

definition: goods kept in a shop to be sold, or a share in a company
sentence: The shop has a large {stock} of winter boots.
translation: В магазине большой запас зимних сапог.

definition: moving or happening fast, or taking little time
sentence: Let us have a {quick} lunch before the meeting.
translation: Давай быстро пообедаем перед встречей.

definition: to give or allow something, especially officially
sentence: The city will {grant} money for a new park.
translation: Город выделит деньги на новый парк.

definition: the main city of a country, or money used to start a business
sentence: Madrid is the {capital} of Spain.
translation: Мадрид — столица Испании.

definition: the man that a woman is married to
sentence: Her {husband} works at the bank.
translation: Её муж работает в банке.

definition: something a country or person has and can use, such as money or oil
sentence: Water is the most important {resource} in the desert.
translation: Вода — важнейший ресурс в пустыне.

definition: a building where you pay to stay when you are traveling
sentence: We stayed in a small {hotel} near the beach.
translation: Мы остановились в маленьком отеле рядом с пляжем.

definition: not including; apart from
sentence: Everyone came to the party {except} Tom.
translation: На вечеринку пришли все, кроме Тома.

definition: the season between winter and summer, or a place where water comes from the ground
sentence: Flowers start to grow in {spring}.
translation: Весной начинают расти цветы.

definition: to buy something
sentence: You can {purchase} tickets online or at the station.
translation: Билеты можно приобрести онлайн или на вокзале.

definition: to think of someone or something in a particular way
sentence: I {regard} her as my best friend.
translation: Я считаю её своей лучшей подругой.

definition: a device for listening to programs sent through the air, or the programs themselves
sentence: I listen to the {radio} while I drive.
translation: Я слушаю радио, пока веду машину.

definition: the number 8
sentence: A spider has {eight} legs, not six.
translation: У паука восемь ног, а не шесть.

definition: a time when there is no war, or a calm and quiet state
sentence: The two countries signed a {peace} agreement.
translation: Две страны подписали мирное соглашение.

definition: a short time ago
sentence: I {recently} moved to a new flat.
translation: Я недавно переехал в новую квартиру.

definition: the day after today
sentence: {Tomorrow} is a holiday, so the shops are closed.
translation: Завтра праздник, поэтому магазины закрыты.

definition: going through a place on the way, or using a particular method
sentence: We flew to Tokyo {via} Dubai.
translation: Мы летели в Токио через Дубай.

definition: an action that is against the law
sentence: Stealing from a shop is a {crime}.
translation: Кража из магазина — это преступление.

definition: the first part of something, or the point where it starts
sentence: The {beginning} of the film is slow, but the end is great.
translation: Начало фильма затянуто, но конец отличный.

definition: to ask for something politely or formally
sentence: Guests may {request} an extra pillow at the desk.
translation: Гости могут попросить дополнительную подушку на ресепшене.

definition: the person or thing that you like best of all
sentence: Of all the songs, this one is my {favorite}.
translation: Из всех песен эта — моя любимая.

definition: a serious illness of people, animals or plants
sentence: The {disease} spread quickly through the village.
translation: Болезнь быстро распространилась по деревне.

definition: known by only a few people and kept hidden from others
sentence: They had a {secret} plan to leave the country.
translation: У них был тайный план покинуть страну.

definition: possible in the future, but not yet real
sentence: The new road has a {potential} problem with floods.
translation: У новой дороги есть вероятная проблема с наводнениями.

definition: to give lessons or show someone how to do something
sentence: My aunt will {teach} me to swim this summer.
translation: Этим летом тётя научит меня плавать.

definition: the purpose of something, or the job it does
sentence: The {function} of the heart is to pump blood.
translation: Функция сердца — перекачивать кровь.

definition: in or from the west of a place, or relating to Europe and America
sentence: Rain is expected in the {western} part of the country.
translation: В западной части страны ожидается дождь.

definition: water that has become solid because it is very cold
sentence: The lake is covered with {ice} in winter.
translation: Зимой озеро покрыто льдом.

definition: to make something known that was secret or hidden
sentence: She finally {revealed} where she had hidden the gifts.
translation: Она наконец раскрыла, где спрятала подарки.

definition: to hit something with your foot
sentence: Don't {kick} the ball into the road.
translation: Не пинай мяч на дорогу.

definition: treating everyone in the same way, or reasonable
sentence: It is not {fair} that she gets more pocket money than me.
translation: Нечестно, что ей дают больше карманных денег, чем мне.

definition: the number 1,000
sentence: About a {thousand} people live in the village.
translation: В деревне живёт около тысячи человек.

definition: a journey to a place and back again
sentence: We are going on a {trip} to the mountains next week.
translation: На следующей неделе мы едем в поездку в горы.

definition: in front, or in the future
sentence: The road {ahead} was blocked by snow.
translation: Дорога впереди была завалена снегом.
